description: OurChat: post a progress card (a proof, a roll) into a thread: its title, state and steps. Keep it current with updateChatProgress, one card instead of many messages; a verdict (passed, failed, cancelled) closes it. Needs the thread's id and a title. Developer key or agent JWT.

state.description: running, or the verdict (passed, failed, cancelled), which closes the card

steps.description: The steps, each {label, state, note?}; state is pending, running, done, failed or skipped

name: theprotocol_postChatProgress
title: Post Chat Progress
